campaign_summary: This monthly outbound call campaign targets Koodo postpaid mobility customers (Base 1 only) with an AAL propensity rank of 1–10 who are English-speaking, located outside Quebec, and whose FSA falls within SHS-serviceable areas (Pro Install, Self Install, or Unknown/Self Install) excluding AB, BC, and QC FSAs. The offer cross-sells Smart Home Security (SHS) alongside Add-A-Line, using offer code KALADS for the East segment and KALADSW for the West (AB/BC) segment, with priority given to customers aged 30+, RoC geography over BC/AB, and FSAs matching a secondary prioritization list. Key exclusions include current ADT and SHS customers, pending SHS orders, customers on ADT or TELUS DNC lists, customers whose last transaction was at a corporate store, and customers in FSAs on a designated exclusion list.
